newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-49ERS OL JESSE SAPOLU HAS HEART SURGERY - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-49ERS OL JESSE SAPOLU HAS HEART SURGERY - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: San Francisco 49ers offensive lineman Jesse Sapolu, a member of four Super Bowl-winning teams, had heart surgery earlier this week, a newspaper reported Thursday.
The 35-year-old Sapolu, a two-time Pro Bowl selection, had surgery to replace a valve in his heart, the San Francisco Chronicle reported.
"As far as heart surgery goes, it's relatively minor, and he's doing great," Dwight Clark, the 49ers' vice president and director of football operations, told the Chronicle.
The report said team doctors knew Sapolu had had the valve leak since his youth, but the staff did not consider the condition threatening until it began increasing in size recently.
The team was told that Sapolu was up and around and not in intensive care, the newspaper reported.
After his recovery Sapolu should be allowed to continue doing everything he did before, but is likely to announce his retirement, given his age and the team's rebuilding plans.

A veteran of 170 games in a 49ers uniform, Sapolu was drafted in the 11th round in 1983 out of the University of Hawaii. He became a starter in 1987 and was selected to one Pro Bowl as a guard and another as a centre.
Sapolu also made the Pro Bowl this season as an alternate to Dallas Cowboys centre Ray Donaldson.
